description:
Get the top N entities of a ranking with honest uncertainty.

Ratings come from a Bradley-Terry fit over the counted votes, each
with a 95% interval (ci_95). `rank` is tie-aware — entities the data
cannot separate share a rank — and `provisional` is true while any
do. `method` says how the numbers were computed.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_get_leaderboard
